answer.sourceLine: PolitiFact found that a blog headline turned Washington’s real comments praising police into this different statement. The interview it checked did not contain this police-versus-BLM comparison. Source and attribution evidence ↗

source.heading: The source
source.excerpt: I support police over BLM, don’t put them down!
trail: PolitiFact found that a blog headline turned Washington’s real comments praising police into this different statement. The interview it checked did not contain this police-versus-BLM comparison. Source and attribution evidence ↗

The fact-check rated the headline Mostly False and reported that a Washington representative told Reuters the quotation was false. Praising officers in one interview does not authenticate a fabricated comparison with a movement. Read the supporting source ↗
